task: Use Gotenberg’s local API to convert uploaded documents or merge PDFs with your own options
packaging_note: Expose the pinned Gotenberg server on loopback. Clients send files and conversion options to its native multipart routes.

endpoints.what: the Gotenberg HTTP API for uploaded HTML with assets, office files and PDFs

access.why: The container network serves the local HTTP address. Chromium and LibreOffice are configured to block outbound HTTP requests.

known_issues: Send HTML as index.html and attach local assets by filename. Gotenberg stores all multipart uploads in one flat directory.
This local service accepts requests from software on this computer. Remote URL downloads and webhooks are disabled.
